blocks.text: The Gerindra Party has surprisingly expressed its support on the Returning of the County Election System through the DPRD. The reason the budget efficiency and effectiveness of bureaucracy becomes the main narrative that Prabowo Subianto's party has to carry.

However, behind the efficiency reasons, political experts and NSL Executive Director Politically Consultant and Strategic Campaign, Nasarudin Sili Luli saw a much larger strategic maneuver. According to him, the Genindra is in the phase of the Bellum Exercise a time before the great war of 2029 begins.

Narraudin analyzes that Gerindra's indirect support for Pilkada is an attempt to reset the defense base. Ez Gerindra seems aware cannot continue to rely on soft diplomacy. By returning Pilkada to the DPRD, Gerindra is moving the fighting pits from open field to a more controllable parliament table that can be controlled through a network of party structures.
This move is considered a way of strengthening the political power in the area, maintaining core cadre loyalty, and building an alliance across groups that are more ideological than pragmatic.
Let go of the Shadow-Shadow Jokowi

The NSL analysis highlights the massive challenge of Gerindra in rebuilding the post-political relevance of Jokowi era. The undeniably winning Prabowo-Gibran in 2024 was a powerful influence on President Jokowi's coattail effect.
Gerindra is now predicted to face a double threat:
The potential loss of access to the power platform if political constellation changes.
Eros from Below: The movement of young voters to parties is considered more popular and progressive like the PSI.
What's interesting is that the support against Pilkada via DPRD is judged as a anticipation if 2029 Gasindra no longer pairs with Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

Here's a gland doing a recalculating. If the political capital of a single figure begins to fade, then changing the voting system into closed (via DPRD) is a way of ensuring that winning through the power of the majority seat, rather than simply relying on the individual popularity of the large electrical field, obviously Nassaudin.
In reality, Gerindra is superior because of the position of Prabowo as President. However, strategically, this party faces a risk of excessive dependence on a single figure.

The Gerindra Transformation became a force that offered counter- narrative against the vast political current of patronage to be the key to the party's survival. Support against Pilkada indirect is a signal that the Genindra chooses to change the field of battle to secure power in the second period.

In the military concept, his choice is to survive or change. Gland chooses to turn the field of battle from open to shut. The Bellum will determine whether Gerindra is able to survive as a regenerative oligarch or instead of being squashed outside the orbit of power,
Nasarudin Sili Luli is the Executive Director of NSL Political Consultant and Strategic Campaign
